description: 6 tasks = 3 domains (p5, hydra, kinetic) x 2 difficulty tiers. Gates: parse/render/nonblank. Blind eval by fixed evaluator seat. Wave 4+: empty artifact = failed dogfood; seat must leave self-improvement product findings (see wave-4-seat-briefs.md).
dogfoodSuffix: WAVE4 DOGFOOD: Output complete runnable craft only. Empty/placeholder code fails. If blocked by Sinter (gate/prompt/tool), say BLOCKED with product defect path. Also give one generator-pipeline self-improvement idea (product, not taste).

tasks.prompt: Target creative domain: p5. Generate a runnable p5.js sketch with setup(), draw(), createCanvas(400,400), and slow orbiting dots on a dark background. Keep it simple and self-contained. WAVE4 DOGFOOD: complete runnable craft only; empty/placeholder fails; if blocked by Sinter name the product defect; add one pipeline self-improvement idea (product not taste).

Target creative domain: p5. Generate a runnable p5.js sketch: layered particle field with trail fade, two independent attractors, noise-modulated color that never washes to pure white, and a prefers-reduced-motion static fallback frame. setup/draw required; no external assets. WAVE4 DOGFOOD: complete runnable craft only; empty/placeholder fails; if blocked by Sinter name the product defect; add one pipeline self-improvement idea (product not taste).

WAVE4 DOGFOOD: complete runnable craft only; empty/placeholder fails; if blocked by Sinter name the product defect; add one pipeline self-improvement idea (product not taste).

Target creative domain: Hydra. Generate runnable hydra-synth: nested modulate chains (osc + noise + shape), kaleid feedback that stays legible, color() that avoids washout, and a second output o1 used as texture source. Must call out(o0). WAVE4 DOGFOOD: complete runnable craft only; empty/placeholder fails; if blocked by Sinter name the product defect; add one pipeline self-improvement idea (product not taste).
